sections.title: Application
sections.content: This reimbursement policy applies to all Medicare Advantage products and for network provider services reported using the UB04 and CMS 1500 form or its electronic equivalent or its successor form.

children.title: Overview
children.content: This policy describes the reimbursement methodology for epithelial cell cytology associated with breast cancer assessment and management.

children.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
content: NOTE: Procedure codes appearing in policy documents are included only as a general reference tool for each policy. They may not be all-inclusive.

UnitedHealthcare will not consider reimbursement of the following epithelial cell cytology analysis procedure codes for the assessment and management of breast cancer risk. NOTE: Procedure codes in this policy are non-specific laboratory testing codes which are reimbursable for other indications, situations or conditions.
